title: Restored late notes replay exactly as native late notes do on an identical repeat
outcome: Restored late notes replay exactly as native late notes do on an identical repeat
acceptance: an identical repeated late note on a restored-completed item behaves exactly as on a natively completed item (append or replay), proven by one test that runs both paths with the same input and compares the receipts and the evidence chain

completion.summary: A retry of an interrupted restored late note now recovers the stored note when the content matches, and refuses with an idempotency conflict when it does not. An identical late note repeated on an item completed by its restored record now behaves as on a natively completed item: the same append-or-replay relation, the same receipts and the same stored record. One parity test proves this, and a recovery test covers the interrupted case. Landed as 5c5300f.
